decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No part of the roof of the extension shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 6 - Reason for Approval

It is considered that the proposed single storey rear extension, by way of its position, design and appearance, has due regard for the sites characteristics and the dynamics of the surrounding locality and would not be detrimental to the amenity of the adjoining properties.  The development is therefore considered to be in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse
